💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
👁 You know this one's trick: it plays dead. Don't fall for it — or do, and be ready when it wakes.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Glasswing Darter: Move when the shadow grows. Watch the shadow, not the bug — when it grows, the dive is coming. MOVE while it falls and it lands on dirt. A missed dive grounds it: that's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Extended Warranty: Never stand still. The RING is the telegraph — the pitch itself gives no warning. Move two or more tiles from where you stood when it dialed and the call drops. It can only dial a stationary target. Never stand still. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Dustboar: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath. When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — tick: Keep two squares away. Keep 2+ squares away and it's harmless — it can't chase. Don't walk up to it. Latched: burn it off with fire, or let it feed full and drop on its own. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Performance Review: Dodge unpredictably. It grades your dodges aloud — so stop giving it the same dodge twice. Move two rounds running, never the same way, and its lock breaks. Unpredictability is the only passing grade. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Reverend: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
